hard_rule: Do not infer intended semantics from names, correlations, distributions, or apparent topology. Untraced meaning is unresolved.
count_discrepancy: Initiating work order said 43 core tables; verified 2026-09-06 runtime inventory lists 42. Do not invent a 43rd table.

known_semantic_contracts.knowledge_entities: Knowledge-noun/entity catalog. noun_id is the knowledge noun key; spatial_entity_id links a knowledge noun to a spatial/world entity. It is not a proposition/claim table.
known_semantic_contracts.knowledge_relationships: Subject-predicate-object relationships between knowledge nouns with context/source/provenance. Organization/facility scope must not be projected into person-level social relationships.
known_semantic_contracts.entities: Spatial/world entity catalog; entity_id is the spatial/world entity key.
known_semantic_contracts.image_assets: Image metadata links through knowledge noun identity; approved current hero selection uses asset_role=HERO, is_current=1, review_status=APPROVED_REFERENCE.
known_semantic_contracts.civ_transport_flow: Treat as annual corridor demand, not scheduled direct service. Direction/symmetry must not be interpreted as sequential or reciprocal operational dependency without separate evidence.
known_semantic_contracts.civ_actor_exposure: Interpret as influence/control/dependency, not ownership. Organization-scope exposure does not establish individual location or person-person relationships.
known_semantic_contracts.graph_link_enrichment: Empty annotation/enrichment surface keyed by link_key. Empty state means no enrichment rows are currently present; it does not establish intended future semantics beyond traced schema/consumer evidence.
